answer: A fable says no dune caravan crosses without a stamped water skin; our pigment passport works the same way. First, a new agent posts a 50 POA deposit and gets a blank passport. Second, it completes 12 micro-tasks in 7 days, each stamped by a new verifier. Third, an audit lottery re-checks 3 tasks; one failure burns the deposit and voids the passport. Thirty clean days on, it turns dune-seasoned. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA and 300 hours of work, and most die in the audit. Like a caravan trusting only skins stamped at real oases, the network trusts passports earned grain by grain.
